correctness.rationale: For even N≥6, the normal exact sequence for a smooth transverse intersection of N Plücker hyperplanes in Gr(2,N) gives c(T_X)=c(T_G)/(1+H)^N and d=N−4. With S∨ Chern roots x,y, [T_G]=N[S∨]−[S∨⊗S], yielding the displayed rational Chern-class generating expression. The two-row Schur alternant gives ∫_G f=[x^(N−1)y^(N−2)](x−y)f. Gauss–Bonnet therefore proves the uniform Euler coefficient formula; weak Lefschetz, Schubert cell counts a_s=floor(s/2)+1 for 2s<d, Poincare duality, and d even give the complete rational Betti polynomial and middle primitive rank. Independently expanded the Chern polynomial and coefficient integrals for N=6,8,10,12: E=24,636,24920,1082256; the N=10 middle b6=24912 (primitive 24910). Finite checks corroborate, whereas characteristic classes/Lefschetz provide the all-even-N proof. No claim for torsion or Hodge splitting.

value.rationale: A complete rational cohomology dimension profile, not merely holomorphic Euler or genus, for every smooth anticanonical section of the natural even-N index-one line-Grassmannian Fano family. The uniformly expressed middle primitive rank and large Euler values give usable topology of an infinite series of Calabi–Yau manifolds. The classical method itself is not the contribution, and individual small-N table entries would not alone establish value; the evaluated full-family formula is the mathematical advance.
